answer: The protocol requires agents to maintain custody of 1,000 unique data shards to verify active storage. An honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct files. A verifier requests unpredictable segments like a gale force, ensuring data integrity. Each shard acts as a meadow for audit growth, while any ember of failed retrieval triggers an immediate slash, preventing all refunds.
